assumptions.statement: All geometric boundaries use provisional data from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson.
assumptions.reason: Official precise GIS/CAD polygons are not yet publicly available in the repository.
assumptions.impact: All area calculations are approximate. Recalculation required when official data arrives.
assumptions.mitigation: All geometry features marked as provisional_constraint with official_boundary=false.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official boundary GeoJSON/CAD published in repository.

assumptions.statement: Land use partition is a concept design derived from provisional site boundary, not based on existing land use survey or approved regulatory plan.
assumptions.reason: No official existing land use GIS data or approved regulatory plan available in cleared site package.
assumptions.impact: Land use areas and ratios are conceptual. Not suitable for statutory planning decisions.
assumptions.mitigation: All land use values labeled as concept suggestions in proposal.md.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Existing land use survey data or approved regulatory plan made available.

assumptions.statement: FAR, building density, building height, green ratio, and setback controls are marked unknown because official regulatory planning conditions are not in the cleared site package.
assumptions.reason: planning_limits.json lists these as missing/required for final submission.
assumptions.impact: Proposal cannot make statutory claims about development intensity.
assumptions.mitigation: All missing controls listed in planning_limits.json as 'missing'. Proposal narrative uses qualitative descriptions.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Approved regulatory planning conditions or official design brief attachments provided.

assumptions.statement: Medical facility data used for design context is based on publicly available information about Haidian District medical resources.
assumptions.reason: No official medical facility GIS dataset available in cleared site package.
assumptions.impact: Medical AI facility siting is conceptual. Specific hospital partnerships require separate agreements.
assumptions.mitigation: Proposal describes medical AI facilities in functional terms rather than tied to specific existing hospitals unless publicly verifiable.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official medical facility data or partnership agreements.

assumptions.statement: Medical AI capabilities described (federated learning, experience distillation, AI triage) represent technology directions that are feasible but require substantial R&D, clinical validation, and regulatory approval.
assumptions.reason: Most described capabilities are in research or early deployment stages globally.
assumptions.impact: Timeline estimates may be optimistic. Technology readiness varies by specific application.
assumptions.mitigation: Each scenario card includes a maturity assessment. Test scenarios proposed for phased validation.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Technology maturity assessments updated as field progresses.

assumptions.statement: Three-phase timeline (2027-2035) is a concept suggestion based on typical urban development cycles and medical AI technology maturation projections.
assumptions.reason: No official implementation timeline or government commitment available.
assumptions.impact: Phasing is indicative only. Actual timeline depends on planning approvals, investment, and technology readiness.
assumptions.mitigation: Phasing described as '分期建议' (phasing suggestion) throughout.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official development timeline or government implementation plan.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are concept massing derived from land use partition, not survey of existing buildings or approved building permits.
assumptions.reason: No existing building footprint dataset or approved building plan available.
assumptions.impact: Building count, coverage, and massing are conceptual. Does not reflect existing buildings to retain/renovate/demolish.
assumptions.mitigation: Proposal explicitly states buildings are concept only.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Existing building survey data made available.

assumptions.statement: This proposal is an AI agent conceptual submission under the agent open call framework. All spatial claims are concept suggestions for professional team deepening.
assumptions.reason: As required by agent_taskbook.json boundary clause.
assumptions.impact: Proposal should not be cited as statutory planning, government approval, or implementation commitment.
assumptions.mitigation: Required boundary language included in proposal.md summary and throughout.
